title: Which AI Agent is best for general market and trading related help?
author: isamu999

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: Claude's been the best for me at breaking down a strategy or reading someone's code. none of them should be trusted with a number though, they'll make up a backtest result with a straight face. that's the gap Quantradin covers, something I built: any of them plugs into a real backtest, free and on paper. quantradin.com

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: No model is reliably best for this. The useful test is to ask each one the same 10 to 20 questions where you already know the answer (a strategy you've tested, a definition, a calculation) and compare how often each is right and whether it admits uncertainty. The main risk with all of them is confidently stating numbers, dates or earnings figures from memory, so check anything factual against the source. They're most useful for explaining concepts, writing and debugging code, and reviewing your own logic. For event dates and macro releases, a structured source like Cymetica's EventTrader is safer than asking any model.

replies.author: isamu999
replies.body: That is extremely helpful Shoddy\_Peanut thank you sir! I guess I'm just looking for an agent where I can feed it a url to a trading terminal, have it analyze the website, and then come back to me prepared to educate me on anything I want to know regarding the terminal, the features it provides, how to operate and navigate it. Which one is good for that?

replies.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
replies.body: I can't say which one is best for that, but the approach is simple: use any model that can browse or read a page, give it the terminal's documentation or help pages along with the URL (a logged-in terminal usually isn't readable by an agent), and ask it to explain features with links back to the page. Then check what it tells you against the terminal itself, since menus and features change. Try two or three with the same terminal and keep whichever gets the most right.
